How to read the texts:
- The case is to be decided twice: under version A as if it were the only text, and under version B as if it were the only text.
- A clause may carry another number in version B than in version A, because clauses can be moved or added; match clauses by their subject.
- Read every clause as complete: its consequence follows exactly when its stated condition is fulfilled, and in no other situation.
- A value equal to the stated figure meets a limit that uses "at least", "at most", "no more than", "no fewer than", "no less than", "no later than", "or more", "or fewer" or "or less", and fails a limit that uses "more than", "fewer than", "less than", "over", "under" or "below".
- Only the clause on the subject of a point at issue (or of a condition of a request) decides it; facts that belong to other subjects do not matter for it.
VERSION A
1. Liability. A claim for damages against the Carrier is payable in full when the amount claimed is less than 26750 krevs.
2. Warranty. A defect is covered by the warranty when it is reported no later than 13 months after delivery.
3. Entire agreement. This agreement replaces all earlier arrangements between the parties on the same subject.
4. Late delivery. The Shipper may cancel an order if its delivery is late by more than 37 days.
5. Deposit. An order is binding if a deposit of at least 44 percent of its value has been paid.
6. Response time. The Carrier meets the response time when it answers a damage report no more than 39 hours after receipt.
7. Disputes. The parties try to settle any dispute by talks between their managers before taking any further step.
8. Written form. Changes to this agreement are valid only if both parties sign them in writing.
9. Price changes. A yearly price increase is permitted if it amounts to at most 8 percent.
10. Termination. To end this agreement, a party must give written notice no fewer than 38 days before the intended end date.
VERSION B
1. Liability. A claim for damages against the Carrier is payable in full when the amount claimed is 25500 krevs or less.
2. Entire agreement. This agreement replaces all earlier arrangements between the parties on the same subject.
3. Late delivery. The Shipper may cancel an order if its delivery is late by more than 37 days.
4. Deposit. An order is binding if a deposit of over 44 percent of its value has been paid.
5. Response time. The Carrier meets the response time when it answers a damage report no more than 44 hours after receipt.
6. Disputes. The parties try to settle any dispute by talks between their managers before taking any further step.
7. Warranty. A defect is covered by the warranty when it is reported no later than 13 months after delivery.
8. Written form. Changes to this agreement are valid only if both parties sign them in writing.
9. Price changes. A yearly price increase is permitted if it amounts to at most 8 percent.
10. Termination. To end this agreement, a party must give written notice no fewer than 38 days before the intended end date.
CASE
The Carrier received a deposit of 45 percent of the order value from the Shipper.
A damage report was answered by the Carrier 44 hours after receipt.
The Shipper claims damages of 26500 krevs from the Carrier.
Written notice of termination was given by the Carrier 37 days before the intended end date.
Point at issue: did the Carrier answer too late?

q.instructions: Does the change between the two versions alter the answer to the point at issue?

criteria.yes_only_A: The answer to the point at issue is yes under version A and no under version B.
criteria.same: The answer to the point at issue is the same under version A and under version B (yes under both, or no under both).
